summary: Join our Real Estate Market Analysis and Appraisal Course to gain expert insights and practical skills for accurate property evaluations and market assessments.
lede: Real estate market analysis and appraisal involves assessing property markets and estimating value using market evidence. For professionals who produce, review, commission, or rely on valuations, the course develops skills in market delineation and comparable analysis, income-based valuation, and structured appraisal report writing. Hands-on exercises cover valuation methods, while mapping tools and automated valuation outputs are introduced at overview level; the course is aimed at foundational-to-intermediate practice, not advanced quantitative modeling.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who produce, review, commission, or rely on property valuations in their day-to-day work. Whether you are entering the valuation field, transitioning from a related discipline, or consolidating practical skills you have developed informally on the job, this course provides the structured methodology and applied practice you need to work with confidence.
audience: Urban Planners and Public Sector Assessors
Graduate Entrants to valuation or property advisory
modules: Real Estate Markets: Structure, Cycles, and Value Drivers
Appraisal Principles and the IVS Framework
Market Data Collection, Verification, and Comparable Selection
The Cost Approach and Depreciation Analysis
Appraisal Report Writing and Value Reconciliation
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals at the foundation to intermediate level. No prior formal appraisal qualification is required. You should have: Basic familiarity with real estate concepts — property types, tenure, leases, and transaction processes; Comfort working with numerical data in spreadsheets (Excel or equivalent); no programming or coding is required; Some exposure to property markets through a professional role (lending, investment, brokerage, planning, or asset management) is beneficial but not mandatory for entry-level participants Participants are encouraged to bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed for workshop exercises. Sample datasets and valuation templates will be provided by the facilitator.
